item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Separate quote verification from imported speaker labels","mechanism":"Track text, timing, and attribution verification separately; imported labels never establish speaker identity.","implementation":"Default to unverified. Require recorded reviewer confirmation for each dimension before marking a quote verified; allow speaker identity to remain unknown.","check":"Import an incorrect label and export an unresolved-speaker quote. Neither may display verified attribution, including in plain-text exports.","risk":"A single overall badge could conceal unresolved dimensions."},{"action":"Propagate corrections through versioned quote references","mechanism":"Append-only revisions update current collections while preserving their original saved versions and imported text.","implementation":"Store corrections with segment IDs, parent revision, reviewer identity, and changed fields. Collections retain saved revision references and resolve current revisions separately.","check":"Correct a speaker after saving two collections. Both show the correction; their original versions and reviewer audit trail remain accessible.","risk":"Silent updates could obscure changes; display revision differences."},{"action":"Export quotes as explicit audio-backed spans","mechanism":"Quote spans cross segment boundaries without assuming that either segment's speaker or timestamps are correct.","implementation":"Store ordered segment IDs, selected text ranges, audio asset ID, and reviewed playback intervals. Export these with revision identifiers and playable links.","check":"Export a quote crossing two segments with different labels and an unresolved speaker. Links must play every selected portion without asserting one speaker.","risk":"Expired links break traceability; retain durable asset identifiers."},{"action":"Provide contextual listening and timestamp repair","mechanism":"Listening beyond imported boundaries lets reviewers inspect speaker transitions and locate clipped or misplaced words.","implementation":"Add expandable before-and-after playback and draggable quote boundaries. Save interval repairs as reviewer-attributed revisions; invalidate affected timing verification pending recheck.","check":"Seed a timestamp offset that excludes the sentence opening. A reviewer must recover it, save the interval, and replay the corrected export.","risk":"Context can inform attribution but cannot guarantee speaker identity."}],"abstention_reason":""}
